title: [3.0-beta7] Warning message to change pump driver after renewing Eros pod
symptom: After changing an Eros pod, a red warning bar appeared stating 'Data is from another pump. Change pump driver to reset the pump status'. The time mentioned in the message is the time of the pod change, but the message appeared much later. It looks like the pump data is not really cleared or updated after de-activating the pod.
evidence_quote: It looks the pump data is not really cleared or updated after de-activating the pod.
